title: Silence as Strategic Leverage
voiceover_full: In any negotiation, the most dangerous person isn't the loudest speaker. When you stop talking, people get uncomfortable—they rush to fill the void, giving away their leverage. Control the room by controlling your tongue. Silence isn't weakness—it's a trap.
